The '''SE-12B blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Cartel Market" /> SE-12B blaster pistols were used by several members of [[Krallet Division]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:RitR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|exp=lots|Retribution in the Rift|Manaan}}</ref>
